```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Default taken from R notebook behavior: when knitting, wd will always be location of notebook
base_dir <- '..'
Sys.setenv(PEDSNET_SKIP_REQUEST_EXECUTION=1)
tryCatch(source('../site/run.R'),
         error = function (e) message(e)) # May not be able to make db connection

# Set to "local" to read data from ../results, or another value to read from db
data_source <- if_else(config('execution_mode') == 'distribution', 'local', 'not_local')

require(tidyr)
require(knitr)
require(kableExtra)
require(stringr)
require(tibble)
require(ggplot2)
require(VennDiagram)
require(gt)

get_results <- function(tbl_name) {
  if (data_source == 'local') {
    rslt <- read_csv(paste0('../results/', tbl_name, '.csv'))
  }
  else {
    rslt <- results_tbl(tbl_name) %>% collect()
  }
rslt
}

prettify_kable <- function(data) {
  rslt <- data %>% kable(digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ','))
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) rslt <- rslt %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = T, border_right = T)
  rslt
}

site_list <- read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_cvg_overlap.csv') %>% 
  distinct(site_anon) %>% pull()


opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

```

# Single Site Exploratory {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r cvg_prep}

coverage_overlap_venn_viz(process_output = 
                            read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_cvg_overlap.csv'),
                          site_list = site_list,
                          output_directory = paste0(base_dir, '/results/'))
```

# Anomaly Detection

## Combined Networks
```{r}

cvg_anom <- trinetx_anom_detect(dat = 
                                  read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_cvg_overlap.csv') %>%
                                  mutate(prop_pts = prop_pts * 100,
                                           network = ifelse(grepl('HCO', site_anon),
                                                            'trinetx', 'pedsnet')),
                                var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                grp_vars = c('fact_long'))

cvg_anom_grph <- trinetx_anom_viz(dat = cvg_anom,
                                  var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                  grp_col = 'fact_long')

cvg_anom_grph[[1]]
cvg_anom_grph[[2]]

```

## Each Network Separately
```{r}

cvg_anom <- trinetx_anom_detect(dat = 
                                  read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_cvg_overlap.csv') %>%
                                  mutate(prop_pts = prop_pts * 100,
                                           network = ifelse(grepl('HCO', site_anon),
                                                            'trinetx', 'pedsnet')),
                                var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                grp_vars = c('fact_long', 'network'))

cvg_anom_grph <- trinetx_anom_viz(dat = cvg_anom,
                                  var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                  grp_col = 'fact_long')

cvg_anom_grph[[1]]
cvg_anom_grph[[2]]

```
